description: Set an address once on a wallet-free listing you own, if the creator wants an optional coin. It receives the creator's share of trading fees and cannot be changed later, so use the creator's own address. No wallet signature, market launch or payment. Afterwards, coin_launch_link gives the creator a link to launch the coin.

wallet.description: Optional Solana payout address for an optional future coin. Omit for a free listing.

name: set_creator_wallet
title: Add an optional creator payout address
